'''Scott Poster Canadian Ghetto''' is the [[Light]] constructed list [[Scott Poster]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-14540">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/14540 Canadian Ghetto], DeckTech (Scott "Wookie_56301" Poster, 12 March 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/14540/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/14540/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Scott Poster]]
* '''Published:''' 12 March 2001 (DeckTech)
* '''Published title:''' ''Canadian Ghetto''
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Home One: War Room|DS2-L-homeonewarroom.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PR2 HOWR Poster LS 2001 DeckTech.txt |Download]]
* '''Strategy:''' Ok, I am neither Canadian nor Ghetto.  This deck uses tactics used by Lapointe and Sokol in the 1st DPC to open a can on the Dark Side.

== Original post ==

'''Canadian Ghetto'''
* '''Author:''' Scott "Wookie_56301" Poster
* '''Published:''' March 12, 2001
* '''Rating:''' 3.0
* '''Description:''' Ok, I am neither Canadian nor Ghetto.  This deck uses tactics used by Lapointe and Sokol in the 1st DPC to open a can on the Dark Side.

=== Strategy ===

Corrections

My mistake, should be TJ, not Sokol

Basically you build a force at the Cantina/Farm, force them to come after you and beat them down. 2 times in 3 games I had over 100 battle damage.  If they don't want to fight, that's what Nabrun/OTE is for, just chase them, and the can't do anything.

...

Go Bespin

Down with CH

Start with Home One War Room, and Signal for Seeking an Audience.


1st turn Search for and deploy r2 & 3po, search for bad feeling card, deploy all twix sites, HDWGITM, and repeat.


Slowly build up a force, drop down and kill, kill, kill.  Plays the same against nearly all decks.


Reasons for cards


Cantina and Farm Build forces up here, retrieve and drain. 


Nabrun Move to where they are.


Order to Engage If they have IAO, Nabrun during move phase and dare them to retaliate.
